authority: plans/PLAN_data_foundation_fx_crypto_stocks_v1.md section 5 (verbatim field structure) + COMMON.md authority-row output rules + plan section 14 amendment r1 (F3/F5/F8)
description: Machine-readable contract for every DATA_INVENTORY authority row (one JSON object per jsonl line). Validator: validate_rows.py (stdlib-only, .venv/bin/python).

license_ruling.description: cite plan section 3 row (LICENSE_RULINGS_VERIFIED.md row number) or the new ruling + its artifact

bytes.description: measured (du/stat) when paths exist; 0 only when paths=[] or truly empty

manifest_verify.description: SAMPLED requires the sample size stated in status_evidence; INHERITED_NOT_REHASHED_LIVE_OWNER requires a live ACTIVE_LIGHT owner with committed manifests (plan 14 F5); a MISMATCH verdict is never written from a possibly mid-write file

start.description: ISO date/timestamp or empty when unmeasured

end.description: ISO date/timestamp or empty when unmeasured

measured_from.description: bytes = this-lane byte-level census; metadata = committed manifest/census fields read this lane; stated = prior artifact claim, not re-measured

falsifying_control.description: the control that would falsify this dataset's marginal value (owner directive: every dataset names one)

status.description: BLOCKED_TRANSPORT == BLOCKED(cause=transport) in the owner 7-state view (plan 14 F9). AVAILABLE_VALIDATED requires a THIS-cycle re-measured coverage/checksum check from bytes (manifest ALL_MATCH or explicitly SAMPLED + first/last/row-count census); file existence alone never implies it. BLOCKED_* rows must name the exact owner action that unblocks.

status_evidence.description: the command or artifact that produced the status; for SAMPLED include the sample size; for NOT_RUN include the reason and the rule applied (plan 14 F3)

outcome_exposure.description: research-vs-confirmation separation tag (plan section 7; OUTCOME_EXPOSURE_MAP.md). UNOPENED windows are readable only by a future owner-authorized confirmation plan; prospective streams are never replayed into research.

validation_rules: R1: AVAILABLE_VALIDATED => manifest_verify in [ALL_MATCH, SAMPLED, INHERITED_NOT_REHASHED_LIVE_OWNER] AND coverage.measured_from = 'bytes' AND status_evidence names the command/census (COMMON: no inferred PASS)
R2: status in [BLOCKED_LICENSE, BLOCKED_ACCOUNT, BLOCKED_COST, BLOCKED_STORAGE, BLOCKED_TRANSPORT] => status_evidence names the exact owner action that unblocks (plan section 5)
R3: manifest_verify = 'INHERITED_NOT_REHASHED_LIVE_OWNER' => status_evidence names the live owning cycle and its committed manifest
R4: local_presence.paths non-empty => bytes > 0 (a stated path with zero measured bytes is a census defect)
R5: outcome_exposure = 'UNOPENED' => timing/available_at must not claim any read; the row must cite the seal (S1 / ERP1 holdout manifest metadata / prospective-only contract)
R6: dataset_id unique across the inventory file (checked by validate_rows.py across lines)
